youtube_description:
I got abs in my 20s, lost them in my 30s, and got them back at 40. Here is what is different about getting abs at 40 versus 25: what gets harder, what gets easier, and exactly what to change.

See what you'd look like with a six-pack, free:
https://absbyai.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=longform&utm_content=abs-at-40-vs-25

What gets harder after 40: injuries and slower recovery, lower testosterone and other hormones, and a life full of work, family and stress. The lifestyle part is the one most guys underestimate.

What gets easier: discipline, money, experience, and technology. I think technology is the biggest advantage you have over your 25-year-old self, and if you use it, getting abs at 40 is easier than it was at 25.

What to change: a low-risk exercise routine (I dropped deadlifts, barbell squats, flat bench and power cleans), shorter workouts done more often, tracking your sleep, intermittent fasting, using modern medicine and testing, and using AI for calorie tracking, a supplement audit and your hardest fitness questions.
